description: fz-sc8.18 builds Stream.map/2 and File.stream!/1 in line mode, each a struct with a defimpl Enumerable. Not built, by agreement: File.stream!/2,3 (modes, byte chunks, :utf8, BOM skipping, :trim_bom), Enumerable.File.Stream.count by reading, and the rest of Stream (filter, take, drop, flat_map, resource, unfold, iterate, concat, zip, chunk_*, into, run, each, ...). Each as in Elixir 1.19.4 with oracle fixtures on all three paths. Calling any of them today is an unresolved callee, never a silent wrong answer.
title: The rest of Stream and File.stream!
